evidence: Oracle MySQL 8.0 release notes state 8.0.46 reached EOL in April 2026; official supported-platform and 8.4 docs list MySQL 8.4 as LTS on Ubuntu 22.04/24.04.
message: Production GA must not promise a database line already at end of life; retain 8.0 only as migration compatibility evidence.
